hypotheses.S0_mixed_coalitions_overlap_less: Mean site-to-site top-32 overlap in each mixed model is at most 80 percent of its paired pure-rule model.
hypotheses.S1_mixed_uses_a_broader_effective_bank: The entropy-effective number of selected channels is at least 20 percent larger in each mixed model than its paired pure model.
hypotheses.S2_pure_coalitions_are_relation_organize: Same-relation top-32 overlap exceeds different-relation overlap by at least 0.05 in both pure-rule seeds.
hypotheses.S3_mixed_relation_organization_is_weak: Same-relation overlap advantage is at most 0.03 in both mixed seeds.
hypotheses.S4_fixed_bank_tracks_pure_site_oracles: The discovery-fixed top-32 bank contains at least 75 percent of each pure model's average per-site top-32 selections.
